# ADR-0001: Static-first GitHub Pages
**Status:** Accepted for phase 1 — 2026-10-22

**Context:** Central index.html, separated chapter lessons and quizzes, incremental GitHub delivery. **Decision:** HTML/CSS/JS pages generated by a Python script and committed to GitHub Pages root. **Alternatives:** React/Next.js static export, Django+React from day one. **Tradeoff:** Minimal hosting complexity and fast content shipping; no secure login, private notes, real payments or trusted account sync. **Migration trigger:** Authenticated students or editorial workflow with secure roles.
